facility.name: Vanguard Academy Katy
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Field Trips

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 21950 KINGSLAND BLVD, KATY, TX, 77450

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Emergency Preparedness Plans: The emergency preparedness plan did not include the following procedures:      Communication   How staff will evacuate and relocate with essential documentation.   How staff will continue to care for children until each child has been released.   How the operation will reunify the children with their parents as the evacuation, relocation, or sheltering/lock-down is lifted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Emergency Preparedness Plans (26 TAC §746.501(a)(24))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: During the inspection, A caregiver was observed in the classroom with direct access to children.The operation has not recieved an eligibility notification from CBCU stating they can be present.    The caregiver did leave the operation during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: A caregiver did not know the number of children present in the classroom. The caregiver stated there was only 8 children in the classroom and there was 9 children present.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: A caregiver did not know the number of children present in the classroom. The caregiver stated there was only 14 children and there was 16 children present.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A child was observed leaving the classroom without being accompanied by a caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: A caregiver did not know the number of children present in the classroom. The caregiver stated there was 10 children and there was only 8 children present.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Report Change in Director: The operation has not reported a qualifed center director within the required timeframe.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Change in Director (26 TAC §746.303(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing: There is no loose fill surfacing material installed to the outside play area.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing (26 TAC §746.4901(a))

occurrences.finding: Education Outside of U.S.: 2 out of 8 staff files evalauted did not contain proof of education that has been translated into english.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Education Outside of U.S. (26 TAC §746.1111)

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A caregiver with a pending background check was present in the Toddler 2 classroom and had access to children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: A caregivers record reviewed is missing 12 annual training hours.    Another caregivers record reviewed is missing 11 annual training hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required: The Director has not completed 30 annual training hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1311(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher: The transportation vehicle that is used to transport the children to and from school does not have a fire extinguisher.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: The Director does not have current cpr training. The training expired on 8/2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The operation has not certified annually the recall item list. Date of last certification was on 11/21/2021.    Note: Correction was made during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit: The transportation vehicle used to transport children to and from school does to not have a first aid kit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: The Director does not have current first aid training. The training expired on 8/2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle: The transportation vehicle used to transport the children to and from school does not have a child safety alarm installed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle (26 TAC §746.5625(a))

occurrences.finding: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System: A caregiver responsible for a group of 7 children between the ages of 3y and 4y did not have 1 child signed in on the attendance sheet.     A caregiver responsible for a group of 9 children between the ages of 2y and 3y did not have 4 children signed in on the attendance sheet.     A caregiver responsible for a group of 5 children age 1 years old did not sign 1 child out on the attendance sheet. The child had transitioned to another classroom for the day.    A caregiver responsible for a group of 4 children between the ages of 4y and 7y did not have 4 children signed in on the attendance sheet.     Note: All caregivers signed the children in on the attendance sheets during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System (26 TAC §746.631(a))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For: A cargiver responsible for 4 children between the ages of 4y and 7y did not state the correct number of children currently present in the classroom. The caregiver stated there were 5 children currently present when asked.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For (26 TAC §746.1203(2))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: During this investigation, it was determined the operation failed to report a situation that placed a child at risk. A two-year old child was left unsupervised on the operation's playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children: During this investigation, it was determined a caregiver did not maintain supervision when a two-year-old child was left outside on the operation's playground. The child was found by another caregiver which brought the child to their classroom and to inform the teachers the child was left alone on the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan-Continuity of Care Until Children Released: The emergency preparedness plan does not have how staff will continue to care for the children during an emergency.    During the follow-up inspection conducted, corrections had not been made.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan-Continuity of Care Until Children Released (26 TAC §746.5202(4))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Two infants who are not ready for table food does not have updated infant feeding instruction sheets.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan-Continuity of Care Until Children Released: The emergency preparedness plan does not have how staff will continue to care for the children during an emergency.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan-Continuity of Care Until Children Released (26 TAC §746.5202(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: A child's record was missing the emergency contact information from their admission form.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit: Two of four staff files reviewed were missing an affidavit from their files.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures - Sanitizing Diaper Changing Area: A caregiver in the infant room did not sanitize the diaper changing table after changing a child's diaper.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures - Sanitizing Diaper Changing Area (26 TAC §746.3505(e))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Drills: The operation failed to provided documentation of the 2021 emergency practices form by compliance date of 5/27/2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))

occurrences.finding: Infant Handwashing - Individual Cloth: A caregiver in the infant room did not wash a child's hands after changing the child's diaper.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Handwashing - Individual Cloth (26 TAC §746.3421(a))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation: Three of four staff files reviewed are missing completion of orientation training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation (26 TAC §746.1301(1)(A))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers- Supervision of Children: Based on the information obtained, there is sufficient evidence to suggest the operation did not put specific measures in place for a child that the operation was aware needed more supervision than usual, to prevent a child from being at risk of harm or danger.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: Based on the information obtained, there is sufficient evidence to suggest the operation did not report the incident of a child exiting an outdoor playground gate that placed the child at risk of serious harm and danger, no later than two days after incident occurring.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk: Based on the information obtained, there is sufficient evidence to suggest that the operation did not complete an incident report regarding them preventing a child from leaving out a gate on their outside playground without permission or supervision from a caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.701(5))

occurrences.finding: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - Secure Each Child in Appropriate System According to Manufacturer's Instructions: Based on the information obtained, there is sufficient evidence to suggest a child was not securely restrained in a safety belt while being transported by the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - Not expired or damaged in accident (26 TAC §746.5607(b))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation Training: The operation allowed a driver to transport children prior to him completing the required two hours of transportation training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation Training (26 TAC §746.1301(7)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Telephone Numbers for Each Child: Four of the children in care was transported without  parent s names, parent's telephone numbers, emergency telephone numbers for them in the transportation binder.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Telephone Numbers for Each Child (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information: Eight of the children in  care was transported without emergency medical transport and treatment authorization forms being in the transportation binder.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: A caregiver was allowed to transport children without having the required First Aid training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: A caregiver was allowed to transport children without having the required CPR training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: The operation allowed a caregiver to transport children in care before submitting and receiving an eligible background check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Sheltering Drill For Severe Weather-Four times a calendar year: The operation have not conducted any Sheltering drills for severe weather for the year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sheltering Drill For Severe Weather-Four times a calendar year (26 TAC §746.5205(2))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: Inside the schoolers classroom there is 1 missing  ceiling tile, 1 torn ceiling tile with partial water damage.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: All of the operations fire drills for 2021 is more than 3 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Letter or form from the most recent Licensing Inspection or Investigation: The operation did not have the most recent licensing inspection posted.       Note: This was corrected when the director printed and posted a copy of the most recent licensing inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Letter or form from the most recent Licensing Inspection or Investigation (26 TAC §746.401(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - List of Children: The operation did not have in the transportation binder emergency medical transport and treatment authorization forms and the parent's names  for each child being transported.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - List of Children (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Fire Inspection: The operation did not have for review a current fire inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Fire Inspection (26 TAC §746.5103)

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - List entitled "Current Employees"--sized at least 81/2 X 11 inches, printed legibly, include employee first and last name: Operation did not have posted a current employee list.       Note: This was corrected when the director printed and posted a copy of the current employee list.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - List entitled "Current Employees"--sized at least 81/2 X 11 inches, printed legibly, include employee first and last name (26 TAC §746.401(9))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The operation did no have for review the annual CPSC (Consumer Product Safety Commission) certification.       Note: This was corrected when the director printed and posted the certification.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))
